report_topic: Performance Audit on Financial and Energy Management by Power Department of Government of Sikkim
observations_summary: The audit found significant deficiencies in financial and energy management by the Power Department of Sikkim, including non-remittance of ₹1,925.55 crore revenue into the Consolidated Fund, off-budget borrowings without legislative approval, and ₹249.76 crore losses from trading surplus power due to improper planning. Other issues included non-recovery of dues, undue benefits to private entities, and poor accounting practices.
